_comment_accounting_donations: Donations for the accounting add-on (D-036; docs/guides/donations-guide.md is the source of truth). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.enabled is true. It needs the accounting add-on, whose managers it calls; it keeps no database of its own for gifts.
_comment_categories: Chart codes a gift may be recorded under: donation categories in the accounting chart (docs/guides/chart-of-accounts-guide.md). A list, so a site's value replaces this one.
_comment_wording: The receipt slip's quid pro quo disclosure, for a gift over $75 where the donor received goods or services (IRS Publication 1771). {amount}, {deductible}, {goods} and {value} are filled in. The organization checks the wording with its accountant.

ngdpbase.addons.accounting-donations.wor.quid-pro-quo: Of your gift of {amount}, {deductible} is deductible for federal income tax purposes. You received {goods}, valued at {value}.

_comment_database: Donations' own database (operator, 2026-10-20): in-kind gifts and pledges. Never the accounting add-on's database. encrypt 'optional': SQLCipher when NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY is set.

donation-record.description: Record in-kind gifts and pledges, and void or cancel them

audit.description: In-kind gift or pledge recorded, voided or cancelled

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Treasurer keeps the donations
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The treasurer role records in-kind gifts and pledges. Recording gifts of money is the accounting add-on's ledger-record.
